detail: The disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 10(5) was submitted by Mark AB welfare Trust to the National Stock Exchange (NSE). Regulation 10(5) requires disclosure of acquisition of shares or voting rights once a specified slab is crossed, serving as a transparency mechanism prior to any formal takeover offer. The exact shareholding percentage and acquisition value are not disclosed in the headline filing excerpt, but such filings typically trigger board notification and potential open-offer obligations under Regulation 26–27 if further thresholds are breached.
